question.text: Record retention under PMLA for customer identification and transactions is:

answer.text: 5 years from transaction OR 5 years post-relationship (whichever later)

explanation.text: The Logic: PMLA requires 5 years post-transaction AND 5 years post-relationship ending — so records of an ongoing client's 2015 transaction must be kept for at least 5 years beyond the 2025 relationship closure = till 2030. The Trap: Simple '5 years from transaction' is incomplete — relationship closure adds another 5 years. Cross-Exam Context: XXIV, III-A. Manager's Pro-Tip: Digital archival systems with tamper-proof logs are essential for PMLA compliance — paper-based systems are inspection risks.
